title: Register controlled sports events and promoters
what: Conduct a registrable controlled sports event (such as combat sport) only once the event is registered, and conduct or promote a registered event only as a registered promoter.

sources.title: Controlled Sports Act 2019 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 39 (current republication (R6, from 16 November 2025; Controlled Sports Act 2019 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person conducts a controlled sports event; and (b) the event is a registrable event

sources.title: Controlled Sports Act 2019 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 41(2) (current republication (R6, from 16 November 2025; Controlled Sports Act 2019 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) conducts, or promotes the future conduct of, a registered event; and (b) is not registered as a promoter
